data.description: Indulge in Luxury with Oceanz 1 and 2 at Maritime City Island
data.display_address: Oceanz 2, Oceanz by Danube, Maritime City, Dubai
data.long_description: The Oceanz towers, located on Dubai’s Maritime City Island, are a symbol of modern luxury. The two towers, offering 44 residential floors, feature a selection of apartments from studios to 3-bedroom residences, many with private pools and expansive views of the Arabian Gulf. The interiors reflect a blend of Italian design and modern luxury, featuring exclusive furniture from Tonino Lamborghini Casa. Oceanz residents enjoy access to a range of world-class amenities, including an infinity pool, gym, floating cinema, and more, offering a lifestyle that is both exclusive and convenient.
